apprentice_instruction: Read the pictured plant, bath station or diagram locus as silent owner.
Use combinatorial prose for Herbal/Bio; local nomenclator copying for Astro.
Choose a registered exact card with the required short default.
OK and OT may take listed quantity, direction, grade and endpoint tails.
OL, L, CHD, CTH and HO take only their listed tail classes.
CKH, CHK, SHED, SOLK, KCH and SH are memorized as small paradigms.
CHEO, TY and longer exceptional bodies remain exact learned cards.
A registered longer body defeats a tempting shorter stem parse.
Choose only a q/sh/s/ch/d/t/zero entry licensed for that card.
Renderer entry never changes the card value.
Order owner, selection, quantity/source/target, operation, grade and optional close.
Break for available drawing space; a physical line is not a sentence boundary.
At a visibly new bath station or diagram namespace, reset the silent owner.
Copy every local Astro group under its owner key; infer no orientation or crosspage join.
